Subject: Recap & Next Steps: Data retention, backups, and log retention (Acme Health)

Hi Sara — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard from Acme:
- You need clarity on Redwood's SOC 2 status, and evidence for a few key controls.
- Retention expectations: account data deletion SLA, audit log retention window, and backups retention for compliance reviews.
- HIPAA/B2B PHI handling: you want BAA confirmation and mapping to our retention/deletion controls.

Open items for Redwood:
1) Confirm SOC 2 Type II status / AOC availability.
2) Provide a vendor security questionnaire (or complete the one you attach).
3) Clarify our deletion SLA (soft/hard delete timeline), backups retention, and log retention policy.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- Sara: Send vendor security questionnaire and procurement contact for contracting.
- Redwood (me + Lauren): Provide completed questionnaire + controls pack (network diagram, encryption details) by EOD Mon, Nov 10.
- Redwood legal: Share DPA/BAA draft for review by Wed, Nov 12.

Attachments I will share from our side: security whitepaper, SOC 2 readiness summary, and a draft DPA. Will attach these to my follow-up.

If that timeline works, confirm and I’ll send the questionnaire back filled-in with owners assigned. Also suggest a 30-min follow-up early next week to walk through any redlines.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps: Data retention, backups, and log retention (Acme Health)

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from Acme's side: 

- SOC 2: We need either a current SOC 2 Type II report + AOC or an attestation of in-progress status with estimated delivery. Our security team requires the AOC for production access.
- Deletion SLA: Our procurement policy prefers a hard-delete within 30 days of a deletion request. If that is not possible, please outline soft-delete behavior and the maximum time to permanent erase.
- Logs: We require 12 months of immutable audit logs available for export for compliance audits.
- Backups: Standard expectation is 90 days for full backups; if you keep longer snapshots, please specify.
- HIPAA/PHI: Acme will require a signed BAA prior to ingestion of PHI. Please indicate whether Redwood is willing to sign a BAA and any limitations.

I’ve attached the vendor security questionnaire we use (acme_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). Please complete and return; procurement@acmehealth.com is the contracting contact.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Khan
Security and Compliance Lead | Acme Health
sara.khan@acmehealth.com

Subject: Fwd: Recap & Next Steps: Data retention, backups, and log retention (Acme Health)

Forwarding Sara's note — procurement copied. Lauren/Monica, can we assemble the answers and artifacts requested? Specific asks below: 

- SOC 2 status + any interim artifacts we can share (readiness report, control mapping).
- Deletion SLA: exact wording we can commit in the DPA (soft-delete exposure, backup/hard-delete time).
- Logs: current retention policy (security logs, access logs) and whether logs are immutable/append-only; ability to export.
- Backups: snapshot cadence and retention, whether backups include KV caches / ephemeral cache and what retention applies.

Target: complete the questionnaire and attach controls pack by Mon EOD (Nov 10). I’ll own sending the completed questionnaire to Sara and procurement.

Quick answers I can provide now: we do encryption at rest (KMS keys customer-managed available for Private deployments), TLS in transit, and we have an internal readiness assessment for SOC 2 with expected AOC in Q1 2026 — but please validate with Compliance for exact date.

Thanks — Jonas
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap & Next Steps: Data retention, backups, and log retention (Acme Health)

Thanks for the ping — pulled together answers and artifacts (see attached). Summary below that we can include in the questionnaire and the DPA: 

1) SOC 2 status:
- Redwood currently in SOC 2 Type II completion phase; readiness assessment completed Sept 2025. Independent audit scheduled; AOC expected Feb 2026.
- Attachments: redwood-soc2-readiness-summary.pdf (controls mapping), redwood-security-whitepaper.pdf

2) Deletion SLA:
- Customer-initiated account/object delete: soft-delete is immediate (logical delete and access disabled).
- Hard-delete (irreversible) from primary store: default 30 calendar days after soft-delete.
- Backups and replicas: immutable backups are rotated; standard retention is 90 days. Backups that are outside primary store may be purged within 30 days after soft-delete, but for regulated customers we can negotiate longer retention or an export workflow.

3) Logs & audit trails:
- Default retention for system/audit logs: 13 months (approx. 395 days) in the security log store; logs are tamper-evident via hash chaining.
- Export: logs can be exported as compressed, signed archives on request for audit slices.

4) HIPAA / BAA:
- We are willing to sign a BAA. Legal will send a draft DPA/BAA for review (redwood-dpa-draft.docx).

Next actions (owners/dates):
- Jonas: attach completed questionnaire and send to procurement@acmehealth.com by EOD Mon, Nov 10 (owner: Jonas).
- Legal: circulate DPA/BAA draft by Wed, Nov 12 (owner: in-house counsel).
- Compliance: provide SOC 2 AOC target date Feb 2026 and follow-up evidence as available (owner: Monica).

Attachments included: redwood-security-whitepaper.pdf, redwood-soc2-readiness-summary.pdf, redwood-dpa-draft.docx

Lauren Bishop
